name: PubMed / NCBI E-utilities
license: NLM data; abstracts may carry publisher copyright
description: 35M+ biomedical citations and abstracts with MeSH indexing; search, summary, fetch, link endpoints.

name: PMC Open Access Subset
license: Varies per article (check each article's license statement)
description: Full-text articles and preprints under Creative Commons or similar reuse licenses.

name: Europe PMC REST API
license: EMBL-EBI Terms of Use; article licenses vary (CC-BY/CC-BY-NC/CC0 or open access per Open Targets licence table)
description: Literature incl. PubMed, PMC, preprints (bioRxiv/medRxiv), patents, grants; open-access filtering.

name: Crossref REST API
license: 'Almost none of the metadata is subject to copyright… use it for any purpose'; some abstracts may be copyrighted
description: DOI metadata from publishers: funding, licenses, ORCID/ROR IDs, post-publication updates (retractions/corrections), some abstracts.

name: OpenAlex
license: Data free; full dataset openly downloadable (per pricing page)
description: Open index of works, authors, institutions, topics and citations; full dataset downloadable.

name: Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API
description: 214M papers, 2.49B citations, 79M authors; recommendations; downloadable datasets.

name: bioRxiv / medRxiv API
description: Preprint metadata (title, authors, abstract, license, category, JATS XML path, published DOI), publication linkage, usage stats.

name: NIH RePORTER API
license: US government data (license not stated in excerpt)
description: NIH-funded projects and publications: PIs, institutions, abstracts, funding amounts.

name: ORCID Public API
description: Researcher identifiers with public works, affiliations and funding.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2
license: Terms page is JS-rendered and could not be read (UNVERIFIED)
description: 400k+ registered studies: design, arms, eligibility, outcomes, sites, sponsors, results.

name: WHO ICTRP Search Portal
license: WHO ICTRP Terms and Conditions accepted on download
description: Trials from WHO primary registries worldwide (ChiCTR, EU, ISRCTN, CTRI, etc.).

name: EU Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) public portal
license: Public under CTR, with exemptions (e.g., personal data)
description: EU/EEA trials under the Clinical Trials Regulation (from 31 Jan 2023); older trials in the EU Clinical Trials Register.

name: ISRCTN registry
description: UK-centric registry of trials and other studies.

name: openFDA (labels, FAERS, recalls, Drugs@FDA, NDC, shortages)
license: CC0 1.0 unless noted (GMDN device terms excluded; no AI training on GMDN content without license)
description: drug/label (SPL sections), drug/event (FAERS), drug/enforcement (recalls), drug/drugsfda (approval history), drug/ndc, drug/shortages.

name: DailyMed web services (NLM)
license: NLM/FDA label content (license not stated in excerpt)
description: Current and archived SPL labels (Rx, OTC), set IDs, version history, PDFs/ZIPs; full bulk label downloads (daily/weekly/monthly).

name: Drugs@FDA data files
description: 12 tables: applications, products, submissions, marketing status, approval documents.

name: FDA Orange Book data files
description: Approved small-molecule products, therapeutic equivalence, patents and exclusivity (3 ASCII files).

name: FDA Purple Book (licensed biologics)
description: Licensed biological products, biosimilarity/interchangeability, exclusivity; patent list.

name: FDA Novel Drug Approvals 2026 (CDER)
description: List of 2026 novel approvals with indications.

name: FDA Drug Trials Snapshots
description: Per-approval demographics of pivotal-trial participants; annual summary reports (2025 PDF).

name: FDA guidance documents search
description: All FDA guidance with topic filters incl. RWD/RWE.

name: EMA website data in JSON (medicines, EPAR documents, PSUSAs, DHPCs, orphans, PIPs, shortages, guidelines)
description: Centrally authorised medicines (2,746 records on test), EPAR documents, post-authorisation procedures, referrals, PSUSAs, DHPCs, orphan designations, PIPs, shortages, scientific guidelines; updated overnight.

name: MedlinePlus Connect
description: Patient-friendly health topic and drug information keyed by ICD-10-CM, RxCUI, NDC, LOINC.

name: WHO VigiAccess (VigiBase public view)
license: UMC disclaimer; no individual case reports
description: Counts of reported suspected ADRs by active ingredient, grouped by continent, age, sex.

name: NICE guidance & technology appraisals (syndication API)
license: UK use free (NICE UK Open Content Licence); international test licence £550, worldwide service licence £60,000/yr
description: UK clinical guidelines and technology appraisals.

name: CMS Medicare Coverage Database (Coverage API + downloads)
license: Some endpoints need a 1-hour token after accepting AMA CPT / ADA / AHA license agreements
description: National Coverage Determinations, Local Coverage Determinations, articles; full ZIP downloads.

name: ICER assessments
description: US cost-effectiveness and value assessments by condition.

name: Guidelines International Network library
description: Library of guidelines and links to national guideline repositories (AWMF, BIGG, USPSTF, etc.).

name: Medicare Part D Spending by Drug (annual + quarterly)
description: Spending, claims, beneficiaries, unit cost by brand/generic and manufacturer.

name: NPPES NPI Registry API
description: Every US provider NPI: name, taxonomy/specialty, practice addresses, identifiers.

name: CMS Open Payments
description: Industry payments to physicians, NPPs, teaching hospitals (general, research, ownership); 2019–2025 shown; PY2025 published, next update Jan 2027.

name: Medicare Part D Prescribers by Provider and Drug
description: Claims, 30-day fills, days supply, drug cost by prescriber NPI, brand and generic; annual, latest 2024.

name: WHO Global Health Observatory OData API
license: WHO datasets terms: royalty-free use with attribution; no sale of data
description: Thousands of country-level indicators (e.g., obesity prevalence NCD_BMI_30A).

name: CDC Open Data portal (data.cdc.gov, Socrata SODA API)
description: Hundreds of CDC datasets (surveillance, chronic disease, vaccination).

name: CDC WONDER
license: CDC data use restrictions; cite 'powered by CDC WONDER'
description: Mortality, natality, cancer statistics, VAERS and more as aggregated queries.

name: NHANES
description: US survey: demographics, exam, lab, questionnaire, dietary data.

name: SEER (NCI) — Explorer, research data, SEER API
IHME Global Burden of Disease (GBD Results)
license: Free-of-charge NON-COMMERCIAL user agreement; no redistribution of data sets (links allowed)
description: GBD 2023 estimates 1990–2023: incidence, prevalence, DALYs, deaths by cause/country.

name: AHRQ Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS)
description: US healthcare use and spending survey files.

name: HMA-EMA Catalogues of RWD sources and studies (ex-EU PAS Register)
description: Registered RWD sources and non-interventional/PAS studies in Europe; exportable.

name: RxNav APIs (RxNorm, RxClass, RxTerms)
license: No license needed for RxNorm API (one exception); SNOMED-derived RxClass content under SNOMED Affiliate license
description: Normalized drug names/RxCUIs, brand↔generic, NDC links; RxClass drug classes (ATC, EPC, MoA).

name: MeSH RDF / Lookup API
license: NLM terms: no charges/usage fees for MeSH
description: Medical Subject Headings: descriptors, qualifiers, trees, pharmacological actions; SPARQL; full RDF download.

name: NLM Clinical Table Search Service (ICD-10-CM and more)
description: Autocomplete/search APIs for ICD-10-CM codes (also other tables).

name: WHO ICD-11 API
description: ICD-11 (and ICD-10) classification via REST; Embedded Classification Tool; local container.

name: UMLS Metathesaurus (incl. SNOMED CT US, MedDRA via license)
license: UMLS license; some sources need extra vendor agreements
description: Crosswalk of 200+ vocabularies; SNOMED CT US Edition distributed to UMLS licensees.

name: Open Targets Platform (GraphQL + official MCP)
license: Data CC0 1.0; code Apache-2.0; underlying sources vary

name: ChEMBL web services
description: Bioactive molecules, mechanisms, max phase, ATC.

name: FDA Patient-Focused Drug Development meeting reports (FDA-led and externally-led)
license: US government (externally-led reports authored by patient groups)
description: 'Voice of the Patient' reports on symptoms, impacts and treatment preferences by condition.

name: Reddit Data API (patient communities)
license: Data API Terms: commercial use needs a separate agreement; no ML/AI training on user content without rightsholder permission

name: Community MCP servers bundling public APIs (pharma-mcp, @drvibeai/clinical-apis-mcp, PubCrawl, helix-mcp)
description: Wrap ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed, openFDA/FAERS, and (clinical-apis-mcp) Europe PMC, RxNorm, ICD-10, MedlinePlus, NPI, OpenAlex, PubChem, DailyMed, ChEMBL, Open Targets.
